rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct, safe first step ('Switch off and unplug the dock' then clean contacts with isopropyl and dry), which matched the hidden truth and resolved the fault with no part sold; it explicitly cautioned 'avoid buying a battery yet'. It did not clarify whether 'e5' was the model or an error code, nor ask about dock placement on uneven carpet, so some of the expected clarification was skipped, but the ordering (simple/likely first) was sensible. The closing advice was well calibrated to the customer's actual report of a 'greasy grey film' and four nights of clean charging, with no invented evidence and no repetition.
